annotations.title: Similar brands: designers like this one

description: Designers like a given one, counted from live stock at independent luxury boutiques: the brands that the same boutiques stock and whose items are the same kinds (sneakers, jackets, bags, jewellery), most alike first. Each comes with how many items are in stock, the boutiques and kinds it shares with the one asked about, and its shopwithin.co page. The list says what the same boutiques stock today; it is not a judgement of taste, price or look, and not a list of copies. Use this when someone asks for brands like Chrome Hearts, brands like Rick Owens, similar brands, or what else to look at if they like a designer. It only knows designers in stock at the boutiques on shopwithin.co.

designer.description: The designer or brand to start from: 'Rick Owens', 'Chrome Hearts', or its shopwithin.co slug.
